privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: How we collect, use, and protect personal data.
privacy.intro: This policy describes how we process personal data when you use our website and admin services. Replace this template text with counsel-reviewed copy before production.
privacy.s1Body: The data controller is the organization operating this site (configured via APP_NAME and site settings). Contact your administrator for privacy requests.
privacy.s2Body: We process account data (email, roles), authentication logs, audit events, and optional OAuth profile metadata. Marketing pages may load media from approved CDNs (see Privacy Policy annex in your deployment docs).
privacy.s3Body: We process data to perform contracts, secure the service, and meet legal obligations. Audit logs and security events are retained per AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS and your internal policy.
privacy.s4Body: Depending on jurisdiction, you may request access, correction, export, or erasure. Admin users can export or anonymize accounts where permitted. Contact your DPO or administrator for other requests.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.metaDescription: Terms governing use of this website and admin platform.
terms.intro: These terms govern access to the public website and authenticated admin area. Replace with jurisdiction-specific terms reviewed by legal counsel.
terms.s1Body: You must not attempt unauthorized access, interfere with security controls, or misuse RBAC privileges. Administrative actions are logged to audit trails.
terms.s2Body: You are responsible for safeguarding credentials and MFA devices. We may suspend accounts that violate policy or pose a security risk.
terms.s3Body: The service is provided as-is for your deployment. Maintenance windows and SLAs are defined by your operator, not this template.
terms.s4Body: We may update these terms or the privacy policy. Material changes should be communicated through your organization's normal channels.
